clues.text: Asked to come and see where this man was laid, Jesus wept, and the Jews said, "See how He loved him!"
Two sisters sent word to Jesus about this man: "Lord, the one You love is sick."
Jesus told His disciples that this friend had fallen asleep, and He was going to wake him.
When Jesus arrived at a village near Jerusalem, this man had already spent four days in the tomb.
At a loud call from Jesus, he came out with his hands and feet bound in linen strips.
Six days before the Passover, he reclined at a Bethany dinner table with Jesus while Martha served.
The chief priests plotted to kill him, because many Jews were believing in Jesus on his account.
